Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Look: Colour scheme of the built-in demo source only (used when in1 is unconnected). original: default colours. mono: black and bone-white. A connected input is not recoloured.
Accent: 0-1. Tints one object of the demo source red when Look is mono. No effect on a connected input.
Exposure: Exposure in stops (2^x) applied before tonemapping. 0 = unchanged, +1 = twice as bright.
Tonemap: Tonemapping curve. none: clip. aces: ACES (Narkowicz fit). filmic: Hable filmic. reinhard: soft Reinhard rolloff.
Bloomamount: Strength of the bloom added from bright areas. 0 = off.
Bloomthreshold: Brightness above which pixels start to bloom.
Bloomknee: Softness of the threshold transition. 0 = hard cut.
Bloomsize: Scale of the bloom blur radii (base 5 to 80 px). Higher = wider bloom.
Glareamount: Strength of the horizontal anamorphic streak. 0 = off.
Glarelength: Length of the glare streak as a fraction of image width.
Chromatic: Radial RGB colour fringing toward the edges. 0 = off.
Vignettesoft: Softness of the vignette falloff. Higher = more gradual.
Grain: Film grain amount (animated at 24 Hz). 0 = off.
